minor.issue: Seeded media rows (via main-agent reseed script) were missing `is_deleted`, `filename`, `content_type`, `size` fields. Query {'is_deleted': False} excluded them → returned 0. After I set is_deleted=False, MediaOut response validation raised 500 (ResponseValidationError for missing filename/content_type/size). I patched the DB rows to include defaults. The seed script itself must be updated to write all MediaOut-required fields.

action_items: Update the media reseed script (used to insert gallery-eventi/gallery-location/gallery-dettagli seeds) to explicitly set is_deleted:False, filename, content_type ('image/jpeg'), size, and storage_path fields — otherwise every fresh reseed will 500 on GET /api/media.
Optional hardening: change the list_media query from {'is_deleted': False} to {'is_deleted': {'$ne': True}} so historical rows without the field are still returned.
critical_code_review_comments: list_media in server.py:924 uses a strict {'is_deleted': False} filter — any legacy or seeded doc missing the field is silently dropped. A $ne:True filter is safer.

MediaOut requires filename/content_type/size but the model has no field-level defaults; combined with a strict list filter, any partially-populated seed row will crash the endpoint with a ResponseValidationError instead of gracefully falling back.
Seeder / data-fixture code should be idempotent and always emit the full MediaOut-required field set.

rca of the issue: The reseed script inserted media docs with only {id, url, category, caption, created_at}. Two consequences on the API path: (1) list_media filters {is_deleted: False} which — under MongoDB semantics — excludes docs where the field is absent, so /api/media?category=gallery-eventi returned []; (2) after setting is_deleted=False on those rows, MediaOut (which requires filename, content_type, size) failed response validation and FastAPI returned 500. Data patch (set defaults) restored the endpoint. The correct long-term fix is in the seed script + a $ne:True filter in list_media.
